scripts.postbuild:
node -e "const fs=require('fs'),ht='DirectoryIndex index.html
<IfModule mod_rewrite.c>
RewriteEngine On
RewriteCond %{REQUEST_URI} ^/_next/ [NC,OR]
RewriteCond %{REQUEST_URI} \.(css|js|svg|png|jpg|jpeg|gif|webp|woff|woff2|ttf|eot|ico|json)$ [NC]
RewriteRule ^ - [L]
RewriteCond %{REQUEST_FILENAME} -f [OR]
RewriteCond %{REQUEST_FILENAME} -d
RewriteRule ^ - [L]
RewriteCond %{REQUEST_FILENAME}.html -f
RewriteRule ^(.*)$ $1.html [L]
RewriteRule ^ index.html [L]
</IfModule>
'; fs.writeFileSync('out/.htaccess', ht);"
